program_name: Bachelor of Education (Honours) in Teaching English as a Second Language (TESL)

requirements.general_text: A pass in STPM with a minimum of Grade C (GPA 2.00) in any two (2) subjects; OR A pass in STAM with a minimum grade of Jayyid; OR A Diploma with a minimum CGPA of 2.00; OR Matriculation/Foundation with a minimum CGPA of 2.00; OR Other equivalent qualifications recognised by the Malaysian government English Language Requirements Local Students MUET Band 3 (minimum) International Students Pass the Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) with a score of at least 550; OR The International English Language Testing System (IELTS) with a score of at least 6.0; OR Any equivalent qualification.
